correctness.rationale: Every symmetric 4x4 Seidel matrix is switching equivalent to one of three explicit representatives, with characteristic polynomials (u-3)(u+1)^3, (u+3)(u-1)^3, or (u²-1)(u²-5). An exact six-pair fourth-order character sum gives combined extremal class count p(p-1)(p-3)(p-5)/96, and a nonsquare affine scaling splits it equally. The sharp deviation follows since 3>sqrt(5); p=5 is checked separately. The symbolic proof works for all p≡1 mod4; 194317 finite exact checker assertions independently corroborate.

value.rationale: The exact restricted-isometry constant at sparsity four and its complete extremizer frequency are natural stability statistics for deterministic Paley equiangular frames. The count resolves how many four-column configurations attain the worst distortion, not merely a one-off small-prime matrix, across infinitely many primes. This is more precise than coherence-only and random-limit bounds; no higher-sparsity claim is made.
